Tests that LLM max_concurrency is accepted independently of the extraction thread budget

```rust title="Rust"
use xberg::extract;
use xberg::ExtractInput;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let input_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"kind":"uri","mime_type":"text/plain","uri":"https://example.com/text/report.txt"}"#).unwrap();
    let input = serde_json::from_value::<ExtractInput>(input_json).unwrap();
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"captioning":{"llm":{"max_concurrency":2,"model":"openai/gpt-4o"},"min_image_area":1000},"concurrency":{"max_threads":8}}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = extract(input, &config).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].mime_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.results[0].content);
}
```
